input:
The teacher's corrections in other learners' similar clauses:
- in “古代的时候”: 古代的时候 → 在古代
- in “他叫孟子”: 他 → (deleted)
- in “他们在墓地住”: 他们 → (deleted)   [her note: redundant]
- in “孟子决定了祭拜”: 了 → (deleted)   [her note: 决定is a mental state verb, no了]
- in “而是他喜欢这个城市的人”: 他 → (deleted)
- in “他跟他的妈妈住在一个小房子”: 他 → (deleted)

Scene to review:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

errors.explanation: Use 在古代 to mean “in ancient times.” 古代的时候 is not the usual expression here.
The boy is already the topic from the previous sentence, so do not repeat 他 here. Chinese can leave the subject unstated when it is clear.

errors.original: 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天
errors.corrected: 他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天
errors.explanation: 孟子 was named in the previous sentence and no other person competes as the subject, so use 他 rather than repeating the name.

errors.original: 但是城市有才两个学校
errors.explanation: Put 只有 before the number to mean “there are only two.” 城市 was already mentioned earlier in the same sentence, so do not repeat it.
